name: nuvraxis-plugins
description: Nuvraxis Claude Code plugins: production conventions for TypeScript, Next.js, nuvui and the Docker → GHCR → Helm → ArgoCD delivery path.

plugins.name: nuvraxis-frontend
plugins.description: Skills, templates and the nuvui MCP for Next.js apps in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo, shipped as Docker images and Helm charts. Install nuvraxis-fullstack as well to add a PostgreSQL data layer.

plugins.name: nuvraxis-fullstack
plugins.description: Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL for nuvraxis-frontend apps: packages/db, migrations as an Argo CD PreSync Job, local Postgres and CI. Expects nuvraxis-frontend to be installed too (plugins have no dependency mechanism, so its scaffold checks for a frontend scaffold first).
